featured_reviews.name: Anirudha Basak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been a part of this gym for the past 3 months and here's my honest feedback:
Pros (arranged in terms of importance)
1. Considering the location, the pricing is excellent! If you're in this area, your usual comparisons would be E-gym (better facilities, higher pricing), Anytime fitness (pan-India coverage, higher pricing), Fitness Size (similar pricing - no opinion as I did not evaluate).
2. My PT (Pratik) is always available, whether it is 6:30AM in the morning or 9:30PM at night. I'm yet to come across a gym which can offer PT across both time slots.
3. Amenities and the overall area is cleaned regularly, good music, AC and the occassional visit from pets make this a favourable environment!
4. Despite full capacity at peak hours, Pratik ensures to rotate me between sets so I have never felt that training is delayed due to lack of equipment availability.

Cons (arranged in terms of importance):
1. It's been 3 months and the third treadmill still does not support incline. Tbh, I haven't escalated this but this should be table-stakes.
2. Changing room is small and there's always lack of space to change into shoes / gym wear (leaves you wanting for more).
3. Mobile network is next to none so phonecalls (via network provider) is a hassle.
4. Compared to gyms which have a glass facade / view, the cardio section may feel claustrophobic to some folks.

featured_reviews.name: vikram shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Atitesh's fitness studio is a great place to workout because of Atitesh. He is a very qualified trainer and has completed different types of workouts. He takes the best of all his decade long professional experience and fits it with the personal health goals his clients have.

Let me tell you my health goal. I know him since 2018. Post pandemic and a shoulder accident I came back to him after 4 years of gap with a 42 inch belly at 40 years of age. Within couple of months I reduce an inch and gain muscles on biceps, quads and shoulders. I can now also do a planks for 45 seconds on the gym ball.

His nature, temperament, techniques, balance and judgment makes him more than a trainer. He will be your health coach at the price of a trainer. His focus is more on getting you fit and increasing your strength while not putting physical strain on you.

One of the USP (unique selling point) of him that he doesn't talk about much is "You only pay for the day you workout". In case you cannot make it for a day you don't pay. If you have a partner, spouse or buddy you can get a heavy discount.

featured_reviews.name: urjasvi gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I first trained under Atitesh Sir for a year at Arjuna, a CrossFit centre—where I’d last felt truly fit and healthy. Now, getting trained by him again is honestly amazing, and my body thanks me every day!

Never have I known or trained under someone who is not only incredibly knowledgeable, but also puts in so much effort to understand your body and mobility in such depth. His goal isn’t to make you thinner—it’s to make you genuinely fitter, healthier, and more mobile.

In just three weeks, I already felt like I was moving toward the best version of myself. Always, always grateful for and in admiration of Atitesh Sir!

featured_reviews.name: Chintan Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been working with Atitesh for 8 years, and he has really helped me stay fit and active. I have been able to keep my weight constant for all these years.

Because of his training, my stamina and performance are great, which helps me play cricket better. During cricket season, I get special training to help me move better and recover faster.

Even when I travel for work or go on vacation, he gives me advice on what to eat and how to exercise. He helps me keep my metabolic age lower than my real age, which is really important to me. I’m so thankful for his support and guidance!

I recommend him to everyone who really wants to invest in their fitness.
